nodes.summary: For all integers $s_0, s_1, s_2$ and every $n \ge 0$, the generalized Tribonacci sequence $(T_n)_{n \ge 0}$ with initial values $s_0, s_1, s_2$ satisfies $T_{n+3} = T_{n+2} + T_{n+1} + T_n$.
nodes.title: Recurrence of the generalized Tribonacci sequence

nodes.summary: For every $n \ge 0$, the $n$-th term of the generalized Tribonacci sequence with initial values $1, 1, 1$ equals the $n$-th term of the Tribonacci sequence of natural numbers with initial values $1, 1, 1$, viewed as an integer.
nodes.title: Integer and natural Tribonacci sequences with initial values $1, 1, 1$ agree

nodes.summary: For all integers $s_0, s_1, s_2$, the generalized Tribonacci sequence $(T_n)_{n \ge 0}$ with initial values $s_0, s_1, s_2$ satisfies $T_1 = s_1$.
nodes.title: Initial value $T_1 = s_1$ of the generalized Tribonacci sequence

nodes.summary: For all integers $s_0, s_1, s_2$, the generalized Tribonacci sequence $(T_n)_{n \ge 0}$ with initial values $s_0, s_1, s_2$ satisfies $T_2 = s_2$.
nodes.title: Initial value $T_2 = s_2$ of the generalized Tribonacci sequence

nodes.summary: The generalized Tribonacci sequence with initial values $0, 1, 1$ is the shifted Tribonacci sequence. For every $n \ge 0$, the $n$-th term of the generalized Tribonacci sequence with initial values $0, 1, 1$ equals the Tribonacci number $t_{n+1}$, viewed as an integer, where $t_0 = t_1 = 0$ and $t_2 = 1$.
nodes.title: The generalized Tribonacci sequence with initial values $0, 1, 1$ is the shifted Tribonacci sequence

nodes.summary: The generalized Tribonacci sequence with initial values $0, 0, 1$ is the Tribonacci sequence. For every $n \ge 0$, the $n$-th term of the generalized Tribonacci sequence with initial values $0, 0, 1$ equals the $n$-th Tribonacci number $t_n$ (where $t_0 = t_1 = 0$ and $t_2 = 1$), viewed as an integer.
nodes.title: The generalized Tribonacci sequence with initial values $0, 0, 1$ is the Tribonacci sequence

nodes.summary: For all integers $s_0, s_1, s_2$, the generalized Tribonacci sequence $(T_n)_{n \ge 0}$ with initial values $s_0, s_1, s_2$ satisfies $T_0 = s_0$.
nodes.title: Initial value $T_0 = s_0$ of the generalized Tribonacci sequence

nodes.summary: For integers $s_0, s_1, s_2$, the generalized Tribonacci sequence $(T_n)_{n \ge 0}$ with initial values $s_0, s_1, s_2$ is the sequence of integers defined by $T_0 = s_0$, $T_1 = s_1$, $T_2 = s_2$ and $T_{n+3} = T_{n+2} + T_{n+1} + T_n$ for every $n \ge 0$.
nodes.title: Generalized Tribonacci sequence

nodes.summary: The integer sequence $(B_m)_{m \ge 0}$ is defined by $B_0 = 0$, $B_1 = 0$, $B_2 = 1$ and $B_{m+3} = B_m - B_{m+1} - B_{m+2}$ for every $m \ge 0$.
nodes.title: Backward half of the two-sided Tribonacci sequence

nodes.summary: Let $(T_n)_{n \in \mathbb{Z}}$ be the two-sided Tribonacci sequence: $T_0 = 0$, $T_1 = T_2 = 1$ and $T_{n+3} = T_{n+2} + T_{n+1} + T_n$ for $n \ge 0$, while $T_{-1} = 0$, $T_{-2} = 1$ and $T_{-m-3} = T_{-m} - T_{-m-1} - T_{-m-2}$ for $m \ge 0$. Then $T_{n+3} = T_{n+2} + T_{n+1} + T_n$ for every integer $n$, including the three indices $n = -3, -2, -1$ at which the recurrence crosses zero.
nodes.title: Tribonacci recurrence for the two-sided sequence

nodes.summary: On nonnegative indices the two-sided Tribonacci sequence is the shifted Tribonacci sequence. Let $(T_n)_{n \in \mathbb{Z}}$ be the two-sided Tribonacci sequence: $T_0 = 0$, $T_1 = T_2 = 1$ and $T_{n+3} = T_{n+2} + T_{n+1} + T_n$ for $n \ge 0$, while $T_{-1} = 0$, $T_{-2} = 1$ and $T_{-m-3} = T_{-m} - T_{-m-1} - T_{-m-2}$ for $m \ge 0$. Let $(t_n)_{n \ge 0}$ be the Tribonacci sequence with $t_0 = t_1 = 0$, $t_2 = 1$…
nodes.title: On nonnegative indices the two-sided Tribonacci sequence is the shifted Tribonacci sequence

nodes.summary: Let $(T_n)_{n \in \mathbb{Z}}$ be the two-sided Tribonacci sequence: $T_0 = 0$, $T_1 = T_2 = 1$ and $T_{n+3} = T_{n+2} + T_{n+1} + T_n$ for $n \ge 0$, while $T_{-1} = 0$, $T_{-2} = 1$ and $T_{-m-3} = T_{-m} - T_{-m-1} - T_{-m-2}$ for $m \ge 0$. Then $T_{-1} = 0$.
nodes.title: The two-sided Tribonacci sequence at $-1$

nodes.summary: Let $(T_n)_{n \in \mathbb{Z}}$ be the two-sided Tribonacci sequence: $T_0 = 0$, $T_1 = T_2 = 1$ and $T_{n+3} = T_{n+2} + T_{n+1} + T_n$ for $n \ge 0$, while $T_{-1} = 0$, $T_{-2} = 1$ and $T_{-m-3} = T_{-m} - T_{-m-1} - T_{-m-2}$ for $m \ge 0$. Then $T_{-7} = 1$.

nodes.summary: Let $(T_n)_{n \in \mathbb{Z}}$ be the two-sided Tribonacci sequence: $T_0 = 0$, $T_1 = T_2 = 1$ and $T_{n+3} = T_{n+2} + T_{n+1} + T_n$ for $n \ge 0$, while $T_{-1} = 0$, $T_{-2} = 1$ and $T_{-m-3} = T_{-m} - T_{-m-1} - T_{-m-2}$ for $m \ge 0$. Then $T_{-2} = 1$.
nodes.title: The two-sided Tribonacci sequence at $-2$

nodes.summary: Let $(T_n)_{n \in \mathbb{Z}}$ be the two-sided Tribonacci sequence: $T_0 = 0$, $T_1 = T_2 = 1$ and $T_{n+3} = T_{n+2} + T_{n+1} + T_n$ for $n \ge 0$, while $T_{-1} = 0$, $T_{-2} = 1$ and $T_{-m-3} = T_{-m} - T_{-m-1} - T_{-m-2}$ for $m \ge 0$. Then $T_1 = 1$.
nodes.title: The two-sided Tribonacci sequence at $1$

nodes.summary: Let $(T_n)_{n \in \mathbb{Z}}$ be the two-sided Tribonacci sequence: $T_0 = 0$, $T_1 = T_2 = 1$ and $T_{n+3} = T_{n+2} + T_{n+1} + T_n$ for $n \ge 0$, while $T_{-1} = 0$, $T_{-2} = 1$ and $T_{-m-3} = T_{-m} - T_{-m-1} - T_{-m-2}$ for $m \ge 0$. Then $T_2 = 1$.

nodes.title: The two-sided Tribonacci sequence at $0$

nodes.summary: The integer sequence $(T_n)_{n \in \mathbb{Z}}$ is defined on the nonnegative indices by $T_0 = 0$, $T_1 = T_2 = 1$ and $T_{n+3} = T_{n+2} + T_{n+1} + T_n$ for $n \ge 0$, and on the negative indices by $T_{-1} = 0$, $T_{-2} = 1$ and $T_{-m-3} = T_{-m} - T_{-m-1} - T_{-m-2}$ for $m \ge 0$, the recurrence solved for its lowest term.
nodes.title: Two-sided Tribonacci sequence

nodes.summary: The sequence $(T_n)_{n \ge 0}$ of natural numbers defined by $T_0 = T_1 = T_2 = 1$ and $T_{n+3} = T_{n+2} + T_{n+1} + T_n$ for every $n \ge 0$. It begins $1, 1, 1, 3, 5, 9, 17, \dots$ (OEIS A000213).
nodes.title: Tribonacci sequence with initial values 1, 1, 1

nodes.summary: The Tribonacci sequence $(T_n)_{n \ge 0}$ is defined by $T_0 = 0$, $T_1 = 0$, $T_2 = 1$ and $T_{n+3} = T_{n+2} + T_{n+1} + T_n$ for $n \ge 0$; it begins $0, 0, 1, 1, 2, 4, \dots$ (OEIS A000073).
nodes.title: Tribonacci sequence

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
